proposed_features.name: office_transit_synergy
proposed_features.description: Combined score of office density and transit accessibility indicating young professional commuter appeal
proposed_features.rationale: Young professionals cluster near offices with good transit; this captures locations where both factors align for cafe demand.

proposed_features.name: specialty_cafe_competition_gap
proposed_features.description: Ratio of office workers to existing cafes indicating underserved specialty cafe market
proposed_features.rationale: High office count with few cafes signals unmet demand for specialty coffee among young professionals.

proposed_features.name: lunch_rush_potential
proposed_features.description: Midday transit activity combined with food venue scarcity indicating lunch crowd opportunity
proposed_features.rationale: High midday foot traffic with limited food options indicates strong lunch-time cafe demand from office workers.

proposed_features.name: afterwork_vibrancy
proposed_features.description: Evening transit activity weighted by bar and entertainment presence indicating after-work social zones
proposed_features.rationale: Areas with evening transit activity and nightlife attract young professionals for after-work socializing at cafes.

proposed_features.name: coworking_proximity_score
proposed_features.description: Density of business offices in walkable commercial zones indicating coworking and freelancer presence
proposed_features.rationale: Walkable commercial areas with offices attract freelancers and remote workers who frequent specialty cafes.

proposed_features.name: young_professional_residential_proxy
proposed_features.description: Non-HDB residential share combined with working-age population as proxy for young professional residents
proposed_features.rationale: Non-HDB housing with working-age residents indicates higher-income young professionals who prefer specialty cafes.

proposed_features.name: mixed_use_cafe_appeal
proposed_features.description: Mixed-use land percentage weighted by commercial intensity for live-work-play cafe locations
proposed_features.rationale: Mixed-use zones with commercial activity create all-day cafe demand from residents and workers alike.

proposed_features.name: daytime_population_estimate
proposed_features.description: Estimated daytime population combining residents, office workers proxy, and transit inflows
proposed_features.rationale: Daytime population threshold is a key constraint; this estimates actual foot traffic potential during business hours.

proposed_features.name: premium_location_indicator
proposed_features.description: HDB resale price proxy for area affluence indicating spending power for specialty coffee
proposed_features.rationale: Higher property values indicate affluent areas where residents can afford premium specialty coffee.

proposed_features.name: mrt_exit_cafe_opportunity
proposed_features.description: MRT exit presence combined with cafe gap indicating high-traffic underserved locations
proposed_features.rationale: MRT exits with cafe gaps represent prime locations for capturing commuter foot traffic with specialty coffee.
